notablePrerequisites: You have no cards in hand.
description:
Activate Phial of Galadriel by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Idle Thoughts by paying {2}, causing you to draw two cards.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Phial of Galadriel.
Activate Phial of Galadriel by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Phial of Galadriel.
Repeat.
